A clean transparent RGBA sprite sheet, no grid lines, no labels, no background, no reference atmosphere, no floor, no shadow, no halo. Full figure with all dreadlocks, hands, feet and weapons clear of cell edges. Left column has THREE distinct temporal poses facing RIGHT; right column has corresponding THREE distinct temporal poses facing LEFT, independently painted views, never apply mirror transform.
Identity reference1 is supplied masked Wolf: SAME engraved silver biomask, black dreadlocks with gold bands, tan spotted skin, black body netting, silver plated chest/thigh/shin armor, orange-brown apron and neck skull, original shoulder cannon and spear. Reference2/3 confirm right/left drawn costumes. CRITICAL EQUIPMENT LOCK: ONE pistol always held in the SAME anatomical pistol hand, kept DOWN by hip throughout ALL6poses. Use only head, upper torso and bent knees for this loss gesture. Keep both hands and arms locked low at hips with weapons clearly visible. Both arms remain in the same low pose throughout to avoid weapon drift.
Create a NEW clean transparent sprite sheet using references only for costume, NOT an image edit. All figure pixels must lie well within each512px cell; final PNG must have fully alphaZERO gutters rather than soft translucent background.
DEFEAT / loss of round: row1 shoulders slumped and mask/head bowed modestly, knees slightly bent. Row2 head droops noticeably further forward and shoulders sag, both knees bend weakly; arms and pistol remain the EXACT low positions and same hands as row1. Row3 deeper weary crouched slouch, upper back rounded, head hanging in subdued loss, BOTH feet still planted. Do NOT kneel, lie down, drop gun, touch ground, raise arms or add second wrist-blade gauntlet. Pistol must remain FULLY VISIBLE in original hand in ALL6poses; wrist blades remain on the original OTHER arm throughout. Shoulder cannon can remain inactive but firmly attached to same harness. Row3 becomes physically shorter because knees bend; DO NOT ENLARGE it to refill cell. Consistent body scale. Six clear isolated fullbody miniatures, no alpha haze behind them, no shadows or atmosphere.
